purpose: Public Wix sitemap inventory and source-backed logic-map compositions connecting the user's research sites to WANGA-LAB.

scope.notes: Sitemap inventory is broader than semantic review. Topic tags are derived from URL/slug only and do not prove logical relevance. Page slugs are not verified display titles. Curated maps cite source pages and distinguish demonstrated behavior from proposed combinations. The inventory does not prove that private, draft, unindexed, or sitemap-less pages do not exist.

logic_maps.name: מבקשה לעדכון אתר מבוקר
logic_maps.logic: Scope defines allowed targets and acceptance criteria; evidence gate checks factual claims; deterministic filter separates permissible edits from out-of-scope changes and publication rights. Actual CMS publication remains unconnected in the demo.

logic_maps.name: טענה מסחרית לבדיקת מקור וחישוב
logic_maps.logic: Fictional example: list price 180 NIS, sale price 140 NIS means 40/180 ≈ 22.2%, not 30%. The article explicitly says the business and price list are fictional.
tests: Do not infer intent to deceive

logic_maps.name: הפרדה בין שינוי מודל לשינוי בקריטריון
logic_maps.logic: Synthetic score 0.75 with threshold 0.80 returns reject; threshold 0.60 returns accept. Model score remains unchanged. Claim is limited to the fixture, not a real client incident.
tests: Prove decision flip derives from threshold change

logic_maps.name: כריית לוגיקה עם לולאת משוב
logic_maps.logic: Maintain source provenance, component contracts, test evidence and version history. New results can reopen an earlier mapping stage; that feedback policy is proposed, not a claim of fully autonomous operation.

logic_maps.name: תאימות רכיבים לפני הרכבה
logic_maps.logic: Check inputs, outputs, preconditions, permissions and failure behavior before combining components. Correct individual parts do not guarantee correct composition.

logic_maps.name: דריפט פורנזי מעדכן את המפה
logic_maps.logic: Drift is a signal, not a cause. Preserve artifacts, reproduce what can be reproduced, distinguish association from causation, then revise the map version based on bounded findings.

quality_findings.finding: Several reviewed My Site 17 logic-box/demo posts append the same three philosophical/economic paragraphs after the page-specific content.
quality_findings.action: Check whether these paragraphs are intentional shared content or accidental repetition. Do not remove automatically.

quality_findings.finding: Computational Logic exposes 12 product sitemap URLs titled 'I'm a product' with generic product-template copy; they should not be treated as validated logic products.
quality_findings.action: Add product names, behavioral contracts, dependencies, tests and evidence before classifying as logic packages.

quality_findings.finding: Some public site URLs contain generic alliance/NGO/business/FAQ or placeholder content unrelated to logic engineering.
quality_findings.action: Keep them in the inventory but out of validated logic maps unless page content directly supports a specific relationship.

quality_control.title_field_note: The inventory stores URL slugs, not verified page display titles.
quality_control.topic_tag_note: Tags are inferred from URL/slug; they are search aids, not evidence of semantic relevance or logical dependency.
quality_control.source_mutation_note: This quality cleanup changes only the Logic Engine demo site and WANGA-LAB documents; original source Wix pages were not edited or deleted.
